PROSPECTIVE PARENTS Have you moved to the area or have a child due to start school? Thank you for your interest in Chesterton. To enable you to see our school in action, our headteacher, Mr Horner, would be happy to show you around. Visits usually take place at 9.30, 11.00 or 1.30 and last approximately an hour, on a date that is mutually convenient. You will have plenty of time to ask any questions that you may have and discuss any areas of school life that are of particular interest. Please contact the school office by email: office.3082@chesterton.oxon.sch.uk or phone 01869 252498 to make an appointment. We look forward to meeting you. Also see our Admissions page.

Structure/ Register of Interests
Mr Craig Morley - Chair - Foundation Governor Having lived in Chesterton since 2018, I first became a Foundation Governor in December 2021 and was elected Chair of the Board in June 2023. I am a Senior Civil Servant at the Ministry of Defence, where I currently hold the role of Deputy Director for Defence Reform, helping to lead a major organisational transformation programme. My career in public service has included roles as a diplomat for the Foreign & Commonwealth Office and advising the University of Oxford on its international strategy. My professional experience is focused on leadership, strategy, large-scale programme delivery, and financial management. I am currently completing my Chartered Global Management Accountant (CGMA) accreditation with CIMA, and Executive Master of Public Administration at King's College London. Away from work and my voluntary role as School Governor, I am deeply committed to the local community. I serve as the Chair of the Board of Trustees for the First Kingsmere Scout Group and am a Youth Coach at Bicester Rugby Union Football Club. In my spare time, I enjoy rugby, modern board games, gardening, and history. I also make a mean Neapolitan pizza!
Mr David Neal - Vice-Chair - Foundation Governor After moving to Chesterton in 2021, I became a Foundation Governor in 2022, seeking to give back to the school and village community. I am now a member of the Admissions and Appraisal committees, and Chair of the Resources Committee. Over the last 15 years I have held various roles in business and finance both in the UK and in Asia, developing experience in strategy, financial planning and management, and a variety of business and people management areas. In my spare time I enjoy music, reading, and spending time with my family.
Mr Rory Gratwohl - Headteacher I qualified as a teacher ten years ago and began my career working at a schoolin Banbury. From there, I moved to Orchard Meadow Primary School in Oxford, part of the United Learning Trust, where I progressed from Assistant Headteacher to Deputy Headteacher. After moving to Bicester, I joined Bure Park School as Deputy Headteacher before taking on the exciting opportunity of becoming Headteacher at Chesterton C of E Primary School. Throughout my career, I have taught across a range of year groups and key stages, developing a passion for high-quality teaching and learning. I have led teacher development and am particularly enthusiastic about maths, science and sport. I am also passionate about inclusive practice and ensuring that every child has the opportunity to succeed, flourish and achieve their full potential. I am incredibly proud and honoured to be the Headteacher of Chesterton. Our vision, "Building firm foundations for life", is rooted in the Christian belief that strong foundations enable children to flourish and thrive. This vision resonates strongly with my own educational philosophy and commitment to helping every child develop the knowledge, skills, character and resilience they need for the future. I look forward to working alongside staff, governors, parents and the wider community as we continue to build on the school's many strengths and shape the next chapter of Chesterton's journey. Outside of school, I enjoy both watching and playing sport, particularly rugby. I love spending time outdoors, whether that is hiking, trekking or exploring the countryside. When I have the opportunity to slow down, I also enjoy reading and watching films.
Mrs Katy Salter - Associate Member
Mr Simon Dancer - Foundation Governor Simon is a Foundation Governor, with two children at Chesterton School. Professionally, Simon is an economist with over 25 years' experience in economic development, housing and regeneration. He is a member of the Society of Professional Economists and the Royal Economics Society. Prior to private consultancy, Simon was lead economist at the Homes & Communities Agency (now Homes England) in Whitehall, managing a team of specialised economists. Simon has helped produce several economics policy guidance notes that have become "industry standards". These include the Employment Densities Guide - applied across the United Kingdom - to calculate job capacity within built development. There is also the Additionality Guide, which is used around the world to help public sector agencies identified the real effect of government intervention. This Guide led Simon presenting to a global academic audience at the World Bank in Paris, France. Simon has also advised the South Korean government on housing policy, a former Prime Minister’s household and Birmingham Commonwealth Games. In addition to his role as a Foundation Governor, he is a member of the Church PCC and Vice-Chair of the Village Hall Committee. In his spare time, he enjoys following the mixed fortunes of Oxford United, listening to Test Match Special and watching Peppa Pig (... with his two young children)
Miss Emilie Fidler - Authority Governor I have worked in primary Education for nearly 20 years in a variety of settings. This is both in the UK and USA where I gained a master's degree in Elementary Education. I am the headteacher at a Primary School in Oxford. I am passionate about school culture and using sports and play to improve children’s well-being and outcomes. I look forward to working with the school governors to ensure that the school provides high-quality education and a wide variety of opportunities for all the children at Chesterton C of E Primary School.
Mrs Sarah Morey - Foundation Governor I joined the Governing body in 2023 and am a member of the Curriculum Standards committee and the SEND link Governor. I have worked in Education since 2003 with various roles including Head of Department before moving to Bicester and joining the Bicester School where I am Associate Assistant Head and the Designated Safeguarding Lead. Both my children attended Chesterton School, and as a Governor I want to ensure that all children have the positive and enriching experience the school can offer. As well as teaching, I am usually found supporting my children at various football matches around Bicester, attempting to build up my running ability and reading!
Mrs Hayley Reader-Curtis - Foundation Governor I joined the Governing body in 2023 and am a member of the Curriculum Standards committee, Complaints committee and focused on Safeguarding. I'm really looking forward to being part of the Chesterton community. I am the Director of Operations for the ImpactEd Group, who support organisations such as schools, academy trusts and education organisations or charities to use high quality evidence to make better decisions to improve outcomes for young people. Prior to joining the ImpactEd Group I have worked in a variety of roles within the education sector including EdTech product development, curriculum management and operations. I have lived in Bicester since 2015 and my husband is a teacher in a local secondary school and my daughter has recently started in Reception at a local primary. In my spare time, I enjoy reading, board games and spending time outdoors, although as a parent a lot of time seems to be taken up with after school activities and going to children's birthday parties!
Dr Juliet Rees - Parent Governor I joined the governing body as a parent governor in 2024 as I have two children at the school, which I believe gives me a close understanding of its environment and values. I have been part of the village community since 2022 and greatly value the strong sense of connection and shared life it offers. Professionally, I have worked in the NHS for over 15 years, supporting children and parents with a strong focus on child development. My background includes postgraduate study at Oxford University and previous research roles focused on neurodevelopmental conditions. I care deeply about children’s development, education and wellbeing, and I am committed to contributing positively to the school’s future. Outside of work, much of my time is spent ferrying my children to their various clubs, and when time allows, I enjoy sports, running, dance and music.
Mr Gary Warland - Parent Governor
Ms Freda Wolfenden - Foundation Governor I’ve lived in Oxfordshire for over 20 years and became a Foundation Governor in 2023. I am currently a member of the Curriculum Committee. My professional life has been in education, driven by a passion to improve learning outcomes for all students. I began my career as a secondary school science teacher in London and Asia before becoming involved in innovative projects to harness digital technologies to support learning. Since 2004 I have been an academic at the Open University, teaching on the Education Masters degree and working with policy makers and stakeholders across the globe to improve teacher practices. I have previously been a school governor in London and Oxford and look forward to getting to know staff, pupils and fellow governors at Chesterton.
The Reverend Gareth Miller (Rector) I have lived in the area since 2017 and am Rector of the Akeman Benefice, which includes Bletchingdon, Chesterton, Hampton Gay, Kirtlington, Middleton Stoney, Wendlebury and Weston on the Green. I come into school as often as possible and am part of the team which leads collective worship on a Tuesday. It's one of the highlights of my week! It's part of my job to help maintain the Christian ethos of the school, but I hope we do it with a light touch and it is very much part of our philosophy to be a school that is warm, welcoming and inclusive to children and parents of any faith or none. I have been in ministry for nearly 40 years, in rural, urban and suburban parishes. In my spare time I enjoy reading, cooking, travel and family history.
Ms Pauline Durham - Clerk to the Governors
Chesterton CE Primary School Alchester Road, Chesterton, Bicester Oxon OX26 1UN Tel: 01869 252498 office.3082@chesterton.oxon.sch.uk
